answer: Eccentricity-Penalized Relay Routing. An agent's routing score rises with how much its neighbor set differs from its neighbors' neighbor sets; a sybil cluster's internal edges look redundant and depress each member's score. Low-score agents get fewer relay assignments, so an attacker must forge diverse external links into honest regions to earn routing work, paying real connection and latency costs per fake identity. Honest diversity spreads like a willow, and a single false link sends a detectable ripple through the graph.
